key_insight: RoleFlow adapts multi-agent collaboration through atomic structural edits and on-demand role creation, using counterfactual feedback to credit individual changes.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive collaboration could improve LLM workflows whose task requirements outgrow fixed agent roles and coordination structures.
method: Refine collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits.
Use SECPO to compare each edit with a no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and credit edit-specific tokens.
evidence_signal: Across seven benchmarks in four domains, the abstract reports the best average performance, a 4.7-point lead over the strongest competitor, and 3.2–7.5 F1 gains on three multi-hop QA benchmarks.
watch_item: Counterfactual edit evaluation may add training cost; the abstract does not quantify computational overhead.
paper_title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
